decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:E 00  Location and Block Plans 17.12.2025; E 01  Existing Drawings Floor Plans 23.03.2026; E 02  Existing Drawings Elevations 26.03.2026;E 03  Existing Drawings Elevations 26.03.2026;E 04  Existing Drawings Section 26.03.2026;P 00  Proposed Drawings Location and Block Plans 04.02.2026;P 01  Proposed Drawings Floor Plans 26.03.2026;P 02  Proposed Drawings Floor Plans 26.03.2026;P 03  Proposed Drawings Floor Plans 26.03.2026;P 04  Proposed Drawings Elevations 26.03.2026;P 05  Proposed Drawings Elevations 26.03.2026;P 06  Proposed Drawings Section 23.06.2026;P 07  Proposed Drawings Details 23.06.2026;HMO Management Plan Dated 21.04.2026;SuDS Pro Forma;Flood Risk Assessment LE2026065FRA R01 Dated January 2026;Planning Statement Dated 21.04.2026;Highway Safety Impact Assessment;Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than eight residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not give rise to unacceptable impacts on neighbouring residential amenity or the character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Prior to first occupation of the HMO, Cycle parking, shall be provided as indicated on drawing "Proposed Drawing Floor Plans P01 dated 26.03.2026", in accordance with the following requirements:o Provision of a minimum of EIGHT long stay cycle parking spaces;o in an accessible location; the store door must have a minimum opening width of 1.2mo long stay cycle parking spaces secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob;o fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.Reason: To ensure the provision of accessible, secure, and adequate cycle parking facilities and to safeguard the character and appearance of the area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the occupiers of adjoining premises; protect the general environment; prevent any obstruction to pedestrian movement and to ensure that there are adequate facilities for the storage and recycling of recoverable materials.

Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, no bedroom or other sleeping accommodation shall be provided at ground floor level at any time.Reason: To ensure that occupants are not placed at unacceptable risk from flooding, having regard to the site's identified fluvial/pluvial flood risk and location within Flood Zones 2 and 3, and to ensure the development remains safe for its lifetime in accordance with London Plan Policy SI 12, Enfield Development Management Document Policies DMD 59, DMD 60 and DMD 62, and the NPPF.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to a Class Sui Generis (HMO - house in multiple occupation) involving rear dormer, front rooflights, conversion of garage into habitable room and alterations to fenestration at rear, with associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage.
